how_to_send._read: SENDING.md. It is the source of truth and this is a summary.
how_to_send.where: In the sandbox. Neither gateway is reachable from the container Bloowatch is read from.
how_to_send.check_first: --dry-run says where a message would go without sending it. Run it once before anything addressed to a group.

_history.to_a_group: Composio tool TIMELINESAI_SEND_MESSAGE. The two fields are chat_id and message — chat_id must be a STRING ("59734285", not 59734285) and the body goes under `message`, not `text`. Get either wrong and the call is rejected 400 before it reaches WhatsApp, so nothing is sent and it is safe to correct and retry.
_history.to_a_person: Composio tool TIMELINESAI_POST_MESSAGE with phone, whatsapp_account_phone '+50769027049' and text. Works for any number, no chat needed first.
_history._why_not_direct: app.timelines.ai is not reachable from this container (the egress proxy refuses it). The Composio tools run on Composio's own infrastructure, so they get through. Direct API calls only work from a Composio sandbox.
_history._composio_bug: TIMELINESAI_GET_CHATS drops every parameter it accepts — types, search, limit, offset and sort are all ignored and it always returns the same first 50 chats alphabetically. That is why the group ids are written down here instead of being looked up. The real REST API honours group=true, name= and page=.

a_picture._why: Composio's TimelinesAI tools send text only. The real API takes a file, and it is reachable from Composio's own sandbox (COMPOSIO_REMOTE_BASH_TOOL) even though it is not reachable from this container.
recipe: In the sandbox: curl the renderer from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moshiko3-lab/-/main/bloowatch/draw_board.py (the repo is public, so it always pulls the version that is checked in).

Write the output of `python3 board.py --spec` to spec.json there — about two kilobytes, which fits in one command. A rendered PNG does not: a single sandbox command tops out around 6 KB and the picture is 30.
a_picture._note: `text` is the image's caption, so the rota and the picture arrive as ONE message. No trailing slash on the URL — with one it 404s. The sandbox needs Pillow built with raqm or the Hebrew comes out backwards; it has it.
a_picture._caption_limit: WhatsApp cuts a caption around 1024 characters. On a big day send the picture with a short caption and the full rota as a second message.
a_picture._two_kinds: There are two boards. shot.py photographs the real Bloowatch planner and board.py draws our own. SEND THE PHOTOGRAPH — the owner was shown both and asked for the photograph twice, in those words. The drawing is the fallback for a night the browser will not start, because a rota with a drawn board beats a rota with none.
a_picture._what_blurred_it: Two things, both mine, both fixed. Quantizing the photograph to 8 colours turns the black labels PINK and the flags into smears — 64 colours is indistinguishable from the original, 32 starts going brown, 8 is ruined. And hand-copying the file into the sandbox corrupted it. Never reduce below 64 colours, never resize, and never copy the picture by hand.

the_drawing.make_it: `python3 board.py --date YYYY-MM-DD --spec` here, then in the sandbox: curl draw_board.py from the public repo, write the spec, `python3 draw_board.py spec.json day.png --scale 2`. About 2.4 KB of spec goes over instead of 40 KB of base64, and the picture is built at full size where it is sent, so nothing is ever resampled. Check the byte count matches a local render of the same spec — same spec and same renderer give the same file.
the_drawing._why_it_survives: Bold dark labels on pale blocks, roughly 25 pixels tall in a 2800-wide picture. WhatsApp's re-encode softens edges; type this heavy still reads after it.

the_screenshot._this_is_the_one: The owner asked for the real planner, not a drawing, on 2026-09-01 and again after seeing both. Send this.
how_it_actually_works: Do NOT copy the picture into the sandbox. That was the whole problem: ninety kilobytes of base64 in six-kilobyte mouthfuls, hand-copied, and three of four pieces came out wrong. A wrong byte is a picture nobody can read, and that is what 'blurred' turned out to mean.

Instead, take the picture where it is sent. `pip install playwright && python3 -m playwright install chromium` in the sandbox (about two minutes; the sandbox is fresh each session, so do it each time).

Sign in HERE and carry only the session: `python3 shot.py --keep-session session.json`. That file is four hundred bytes, and it is a signed-in browser, not the password — the sandbox never learns the password.

In the sandbox: curl shot.py and tighten.py FROM THE COMMIT SHA, not from a branch name — raw.githubusercontent serves a stale branch copy for minutes and you will run yesterday's code without noticing.
`python3 shot.py --date YYYY-MM-DD --session session.json --out real.png`, then tighten it, then POST it. Nothing is copied by hand at any point.
the_screenshot._the_session_file: A revocable token, gitignored, and it must stay that way. If the owner would rather not have it sitting in the sandbox: refresh it nightly, or ask him for a read-only Bloowatch user.
the_screenshot.make_it: BLOOWATCH_EMAIL/PASSWORD set, then `python3 shot.py --out full.png`, then `python3 tighten.py full.png board.png --strips 3 --colours 8`. Never resize: shrinking is what made the first attempts unreadable. tighten.py drops the crew rows with nothing booked and the grey group dividers, then cuts the day into three stacked strips with a little overlap, so the picture keeps every pixel Bloowatch drew and still comes out about 1.6:1 — a shape WhatsApp will show. A quiet day lands near 28 KB; a full one is bigger, so raise --strips rather than shrinking.
the_screenshot._aspect: WhatsApp silently drops a very wide picture: a 4:1 board arrived as text only although TimelinesAI reported has_attachment true. Anything up to about 2:1 has arrived. Keep the strips coming until the shape is under that.
the_screenshot._colours: 8 colours is fine at full resolution — the planner is flat colour and the text keeps its edges. The old warning about 16 being the floor applied to a downscaled picture, where the text had too few pixels to survive.
the_screenshot.carry_it: base64 it and paste it into the sandbox in pieces of 5000 characters, appending each to the same file — a single message cannot carry more than roughly 6.9 KB, and a longer paste is silently cut with no error. Check `wc -c` after every piece: it must grow by exactly 5000, and a short one means the paste itself was wrong, not the transport. About eight pieces. After the last one, `base64 -d` it and check the byte count and md5 match before sending.
the_screenshot._why_not_smaller: app.timelines.ai is unreachable from this container, so the file has to travel to the sandbox, and the sandbox has no browser to take the shot itself.

rules: Nothing goes to a group without the owner having approved that exact message going to that exact group.
A group only appears in TimelinesAI once a message arrives in it; it does not backfill history.
